Team / Sam,

Quick note to start the transport thread for next week's ACME workshop (Wed–Thu). Short summary of constraints: the Midtown loading lane is single-lane, curb window is tight (10 minutes per drop), and the perimeter security gate has a manual scan process that can add ~3–5 mins per vehicle. We need a plan that keeps exec arrivals on-time without blocking attendees.

Proposed asks:
- Confirm vanpool arrival windows and number of vehicles (Sam)
- Charter car service for VIP pickups (Marcus to confirm vendor)
- Reserve 4 curb spots for 09:00–10:30 + overflow shuttle loop to Lot D
- Gate badge pre-registration for drivers to avoid manual queues

Attached: vanpool_manifest.xlsx (draft), site-map.png (pickup/drop overlay).

Sam — can you confirm final headcount + any VIP timing constraints by EOD today? HarborValet and EliteCar are copied so they can respond with capacity/route constraints.

Thanks,
Priyom

Understood — routing and contingency suggested below.

Primary plan:
- Reserve north curb x2 (08:30–10:30) and south curb x2 (08:45–10:15) with 10-minute staggered windows.
- HarborValet to stage overflow on Third Ave Lot D; shuttle loop runtime ~8 mins (continuous).
- Pre-register driver badge IDs in bulk to the gate manifest (HarborValet will email CSV).

Contingency (if gate queue > 7 mins):
- Use Lot D as holding area and call ahead to drivers for sequential release.
- Shift non-VIP drops to 10:15–10:45 (short delay) and hold VIPs as priority.
